scope: Complete universal-length index for one published prime-cycle DFA instance; no new complexity classification or least-length result.

primary_source.title: Existential Length Universality
primary_source.family: Rejecting initial state; symbol a_i enters position zero of prime cycle p_i, every later symbol advances, and only position p_i-1 is final.
primary_source.prior_result: For positive lengths, universality holds precisely at multiples of 210. The empty word is rejected. This known source-family consequence is credited.

implementation.runtime: pure CommonJS-compatible JavaScript with BigInt, executed in connected V8
implementation.source_authentication: Caller responsibility; source_id is a provenance label, not an authentication mechanism.

compile_execution.limitations: one bounded actual input; no statistical benchmark

rejection.ordering: deterministic retained predecessor choices; no lexicographic minimum claim

retained_consumer.scope: one retained-data consumer; no automaton family or subset-transition recomputation
